lines.targetText: Good morning, Elly. I have an idea.
lines.englishReference: Good morning, Elly. I have an idea.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير يا إيلي. لدي فكرة.
lines.pronunciation: Good morning, Elly. I have an idea.

lines.targetText: The old shed can be useful.
lines.englishReference: The old shed can be useful.
lines.arabicTranslation: السقيفة القديمة يمكن أن تكون مفيدة.
lines.pronunciation: The old shed can be useful.

lines.targetText: First, we clean it. Then, we fix the roof.
lines.englishReference: First, we clean it. Then, we fix the roof.
lines.pronunciation: First, we clean it. Then, we fix the roof.

lines.targetText: After that, we put the tools inside.

lines.arabicTranslation: بعد ذلك نضع الأدوات في الداخل.
lines.pronunciation: After that, we put the tools inside.

lines.targetText: That is a good plan. See you at the shed.
lines.englishReference: That is a good plan. See you at the shed.
lines.arabicTranslation: هذه خطة جيدة. أراك عند السقيفة.
lines.pronunciation: That is a good plan. See you at the shed.
